mentions.name: Pace and Push
mentions.description: This app is a ranking system that combines a user's running distance with their total GitHub commits to gamify staying productive and healthy. It can be integrated into a GitHub profile and is available as an iOS beta.
mentions.problem: Lack of motivation to stay productive and healthy; the ranking system is built to motivate the author to be productive and healthy while having fun.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a ranking system that combines my running distance with my total commits. Mostly to motivate myself to be productive and healthy, and also just to have fun. I integrated it into my GitHub profile

evidence.value: I’m working on a ranking system that combines my running distance with my total commits. Mostly to motivate myself to be productive and healthy, and also just to have fun. I integrated it into my GitHub profile
